_readme: Source signatures for live + retroactive identification. Data, not code, so it
is diffable and testable offline. Loaded by sources.py; scored against the
live 30 s ring and (later) against archive windows.
Every signature is EPOCH-STAMPED. Everything we measure depends on the
acquisition configuration, and this station has already had three epochs in a
week -- a signature with no valid_from will be quietly wrong the first time the
front end is touched. sources.py refuses to apply one outside its epoch.
status: 'provisional' until the activity has been observed on >= 2 SEPARATE
days. Provisional signatures are shown with a hedge in the UI. Thresholds are
deliberately set for RECALL, not precision: false positives are currently cheap

The evidence block is the receipts. Keep it honest -- a year from now it is the only way to know that garage-appliance-20hz rests on a single afternoon, and that it started life as a washer detector until the dryer proved it wasn't one.

signatures.label: garage appliance running
signatures.hint: washer or dryer — the two are NOT separable (measured)

evidence.measured: washer line 19.34-19.97 Hz, ASD 4.8-9.5; dryer line 19.92-20.02 Hz, ASD 4.2-7.6. Line/broadband ratio washer 14-28, dryer 16-22. Complete overlap on every feature tried.
notes: RENAMED from washer-spin 2026-07-26: Charles reported the dryer running and it produced the
SAME ~20 Hz line at the same strength. The caveat 'a dryer would look the same' was written as a
hypothetical an hour earlier and is now a measurement. This signature detects an appliance, full stop.
Separating washer from dryer needs a feature we do not have; duty-cycle shape (washer bursts 139-475 s
with shortening gaps vs dryer's longer run) is the most promising untried angle.
One control window (2026-07-26T02:00Z, 19:00 PDT Sat) trips this rule at 3.01 / 9.2 -- plausibly an
unlabelled real run rather than a false positive. Unresolved.
Thresholds set for RECALL: false positives are currently cheap and become the labelling queue.

standing_lines.note: persistent, present at full strength in dead quiet; NOT a washer harmonic. Scores ~10x over its own continuum with no source running -- the reason line rules must compare amplitude against a reference, not just against the local continuum.
weak standing line at 0.4-1.4 uV/rtHz. Both appliances sit on top of this, which is why min_asd exists alongside the shape term.
known instrumental line, long-standing and unattributed (see STATUS.md). Out of band for these rules.
